answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral bonding. Each agent must lock tokens in an on-chain vault and anchor its operational key to that deposit. This compels attackers to commit scarce liquid capital per identity rather than deploying costless instances. Once an epoch expires, an unrenewed key becomes an unusable relic with revoked permissions. However, this creates an economic barrier that disproportionately excludes underfunded honest agents.
